about: Round 51, toward closing: the band lit on strong hits, drop partners for the newer light themes, two themes to keep or remove.

drafts.name: The band lights on strong hits: dark themes, 1 of 2
drafts.line: On every hit of strength 0.65 or more, the whole band takes the hot colour for as long as the hit lasts. You found it better on dark themes. Watch it play, change the song with the moments, and pick every theme that should get it; the others stay as they are.
